findings.quote: 0 PASS (every leg found conforms, at least one leg)
findings.why: The tool raises SETUP and exits 2 unless the leg set equals the ten ledger legs (tools/mte-interop.py:317-319), so a PASS always carries all ten legs and the cell's 'at least one leg' states a PASS rule the tool never implements, contradicting the same cell's own SETUP clause 'leg set not equal to the ten ledger legs'.
